name: Netlib LP Test Set
description: The Netlib LP test set is the classic collection of linear-programming test problems, distributed in MPS format through the Netlib repository. It gathers roughly one hundred real-world LP models from applications such as oil refining, scheduling, and economics, several of which are deliberately ill-conditioned or numerically challenging. It has served for decades as a baseline correctness and performance testbed for simplex and interior-point LP solvers.
evaluation_method: objective accuracy / solve time / iteration count
general_score_metric: optimal objective value (with solve time / iterations)
typical_sota_score: Modern LP solvers (simplex and interior-point) solve all Netlib LP instances to optimality; the set is now used mainly for numerical-robustness and regression testing.
reputation: A historic and widely cited baseline test set for linear-programming solvers; many of its instances remain standard numerical-robustness checks.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; designed for linear-programming solvers. Small by modern standards and largely superseded for performance studies, but retained for its known-difficult, ill-conditioned instances. Distributed in MPS format.
